canonical.title: IT conferences and tech events in Zwolle

parent.title: A weekend in Zwolle around a Michelin dinner

siblings.title: Things to do in Zwolle
siblings.summary: A weekend in Zwolle anchored on the Michelin dinner: star-shaped old town, Museum de Fundatie, canal boat, the bookshop-in-a-church, and easy Hanseatic day trips.

siblings.title: Michelin 2 and 3-star restaurants in Zwolle
siblings.summary: Zwolle proper has one starred pick — De Librije (3★). The nearest 2★ options sit 30–55 km away; one of them closes for good before the weekend.

sources.title: DevSessions Zwolle (Meetup)
sources.claim: DevSessions Zwolle (formerly WebDev Zwolle, rebranded 2026) is a 967-member meetup hosted by Arcady.

sources.title: DevPulse Zwolle (Meetup)
sources.claim: DevPulse Zwolle is a 652-member developer meetup at De Makersfabriek, running approximately quarterly with upcoming editions Sep 3 2026 and Dec 3 2026.

sources.title: DevPulse #5 — ZWINC
sources.claim: DevPulse is free (dinner & drinks included), organized by CloudProud with support from ZWINC and Digital District Zwolle.

sources.title: Perron038
sources.claim: Perron038, Hanzelaan 95B Zwolle, is the regional open innovation hub for high-tech manufacturing.

sources.title: Spoorzone Zwolle events
sources.claim: Spoorzone Zwolle event calendar lists Demodag Perron038 (Jun 2), Additive Manufacturing Kennisevent (Jun 5), Innovation Day (Jun 11), and Boost Summit (Jun 17).

sources.title: PROTO Innovation Day Zwolle
sources.claim: PROTO Innovation Day Zwolle is a one-day knowledge festival; €100 ex VAT, at De Binnenplaats Hanzelaan 95B, from 13:00.

sources.title: Winnovation — Windesheim
sources.claim: Winnovation is the Windesheim HBO-ICT student showcase, held twice a year (Jan 15 and Jun 11 2026).

sources.title: ZWINC (Zwolle Incubator)
sources.claim: ZWINC supports manufacturing and IT startups from De Makersfabriek, the former Philips factory on Ceintuurbaan.

sources.title: Arcady
sources.claim: Arcady is a Zwolle software consultancy at Burgemeester Roelenweg 13K that powers DevSessions Zwolle.

sources.title: Digital District Zwolle
sources.claim: Digital District Zwolle is the regional IT network connecting 100+ organisations.

sources.title: Regio Zwolle IT Platform
sources.claim: Regio Zwolle IT Platform aggregates the region's IT companies, jobs and events; organizes monthly IT Café meetups.

sources.title: DEVWorld 2026
sources.claim: DEVWorld 2026 is the largest multi-language developer conference in the Netherlands, held in Amsterdam.

sources.title: Windesheim × ZWINC partnership
sources.claim: ZWINC partners with Windesheim and is positioned as the place for innovative start-ups in the Zwolle region.

sources.title: Winnovation summer 2026 — Windesheim HBO-ICT
sources.claim: Winnovation summer edition takes place Jun 11 2026 at Windesheim Campus 2, Building X.
